metadata.chapter_title: Urban Flood modelling and Green Infrastructure
metadata.chapter_subtitle: Runoff generation and mitigation in developed watersheds

inventory.summary: The chapter needed better front-loaded guidance on rate, volume, and storage, and several applied expressions contained malformed math.
issues: The chapter lacked the standard onboarding block.
Several detention and cost lines contained malformed inline math.
The chapter needed a clearer distinction between runoff volume, peak discharge, and storage.

rewrite.summary: Completed a full editorial pass that added onboarding, clarified conceptual categories, and repaired the applied math lines.
editor_notes: Added a Before You Start block.
Clarified the difference between amount, rate, and travel time.
Repaired malformed detention, bioretention, and cost expressions.

qa_review.summary: The chapter now reads more coherently for beginners and the applied calculations are mathematically clean.

repair.summary: The notation and pacing issues were repaired during the chapter rewrite.
actions_taken: Improved the conceptual separation between runoff volume, discharge, and storage.
Corrected the malformed detention, area, and cost expressions.

design_review.summary: The chapter's green-infrastructure examples and sizing sequence now better support interpretation of the applied design choices.
improvements_made: Improved interpretive support by cleaning the applied detention and green-infrastructure examples.
